example deployment/payment, service/cart, node/<node name>); for one of the shop's feature flags,

A `catalog-maintenance` job opened a transaction, took an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock on `catalog.products` and then sat in `pg_sleep`. Every product query waits behind the lock until the role's 3 s lock_timeout cancels it, so every product page fails. The job retries in a loop, so ending only its database session gets the lock taken again within seconds; deleting only the job leaves its session running (Postgres does not notice the vanished client while the statement runs), still holding the lock. Both are needed: stop the job, then end its session.
